items.name: dotted-world-map
items.title: Dotted World Map
items.description: A dependency-free SVG world map drawn with dots, tinted by heat value. Ships with interactive markers, tooltips, and a GitHub-style legend.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: copy-command-block
items.title: Copy Command Block
items.description: A multi-package manager terminal command box with tab switcher (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun), persistent storage, copy feedback animation, and blueprint styling.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: github-map
items.title: GitHub Heatmap
items.description: An interactive 52-week contribution activity graph with date-fns interval calculation, theme-aware level colors, and date tooltips.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: project-explorer
items.title: Interactive Project Explorer
items.description: An IDE-style project showcase with collapsible year folders, status badges, and floating cursor image hover previews.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: Multi-layered gradient backdrop blur overlay with exponential Gaussian steps and directional masking for sticky navbars and cards.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: infinite-slider
items.title: Infinite Slider
items.description: A continuous looping marquee slider powered by Motion and React Use Measure with custom gap, speed, direction, and hover deceleration.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: carousel
items.title: Fluid Carousel
items.description: Accessible touch-swipeable slide carousel with directional spring animations, keyboard arrow navigation, and pagination indicators.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: mode-toggler
items.title: Mode Toggler
items.description: A minimal Sun / Moon theme toggle button built on next-themes. Supports an optional click sound, composable className, and dynamic aria-label.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: interactive-skill-cloud
items.title: Interactive Skill Cloud
items.description: A draggable physics pill cloud powered by matter.js — pills rain down, pile at the bottom, and collide; grab one and fling it.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>

items.name: contact-channels
items.title: Contact Channels
items.description: A hairline grid of contact cells with copy-to-clipboard actions, single-key shortcuts, tooltips, and blueprint hover styling.
items.author: Aditya Ojha <https://akoder.xyz>
